outlooks.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH DAMAGING WIND AND POSSIBLY A FEW TORNADOES ARE EXPECTED TODAY OVER PARTS OF THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS AND MID-ATLANTIC...INCLUDING THE AREAS MAINLY WEST AND NORTH OF WASHINGTON/BALTIMORE AND PHILADELPHIA. OTHER STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS MAY OCCUR FROM THE GREAT BASIN AND SOUTHERN ROCKIES INTO THE SOUTHERN PLAINS.

sections.title: SYNOPTIC SETUP
sections.text: SPLIT FLOW WILL PREVAIL OVER THE LWR 48 THIS PERIOD...DOWNSTREAM FROM SLOWLY PROGRESSIVE CA UPR LOW. A SHORTWAVE TROUGH IN THE LOW WILL PIVOT NE INTO SRN NV BY THIS EVE AS A DOWNSTREAM SRN BRANCH IMPULSE MOVES FROM NW OK TO WRN MO. IN THE EAST...SEASONABLY STRONG BUT LOW-AMPLITUDE SRN BRANCH DISTURBANCE THAT CROSSED THE OZARKS/LWR OH VLY YESTERDAY IS NOW OVER IND. THE TROUGH SHOULD CONTINUE ENE INTO WRN PA/MD THIS AFTN...BEFORE TURNING E OFF THE NJ CST TNGT/EARLY FRI. AT THE SFC...LOW ASSOCIATED WITH IND TROUGH WILL REACH NW PA THIS AFTN...WHILE WAVY WARM FRONT EXTENDING TO ITS E/SE EDGES N ACROSS ERN PA/NJ. COLD FRONT TRAILING WSW FROM THE LOW WILL SETTLE SLOWLY S ACROSS THE OH VLY...WHILE LEE TROUGH BECOMES BETTER DEFINED E OF THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS. THE COLD FRONT WILL BECOME STNRY OVER THE OZARKS LATER TODAY...WHILE THE WRN END REDEVELOPS NWD AS A WARM FRONT ACROSS THE SRN PLNS.

sections.title: CNTRL APPALACHIANS/MID-ATLANTIC TODAY THROUGH EARLY TNGT
sections.text: BAND OF SEASONABLY STRONG /40+ KT/ 700-500 MB WSW FLOW ATTENDANT TO IND UPR VORT WILL OVERSPREAD THE UPR OH VLY LATER THIS MORNING AND REACH THE MID-ATLANTIC CST BY EVE...ACCOMPANIED BY SUBSTANTIAL MOISTURE RETURN /PW INCREASING TO AOA 2.00 INCHES/. MID-LVL LAPSE RATES WILL BE WEAK. BUT GIVEN MOISTURE QUALITY...MODERATE TO STRONG SFC HEATING SHOULD BOOST MLCAPE TO AROUND 1500 J/KG...ESPECIALLY E OF THE MOUNTAINS. DEEP...UNIDIRECTIONAL WSW UPSLOPE FLOW COULD SUPPORT INTENSIFICATION OF EXISTING MID-OH VLY CONVECTIVE BAND...AND/OR DEVELOPMENT OF ADDITIONAL STORMS TO ITS EAST...OVER ERN KY/SRN OH/WV TOWARD MIDDAY. OTHER STORMS SHOULD DEVELOP LATER THIS AFTN ALONG LEE TROUGH OVER CNTRL MD/NRN VA...AND ALONG WARM FRONT OVER THE LWR SUSQUEHANNA AND DELAWARE VLYS OF CNTRL/NRN PA AND NE MD...DE...NJ. COMBINATION OF DEEP...UNIDIRECTIONAL FLOW AND RICH MOISTURE SUGGESTS THE POTENTIAL FOR BOWING SEGMENTS WITH DMGG WIND GUSTS AS THE STORMS ORGANIZE INTO A SQLN OVER WV AND WRN PORTIONS OF PA/MD THIS AFTN. IN ADDITION...ENHANCED LOW-LVL SHEAR NEAR WARM FRONT AND NEAR LEE TROUGH/WARM FRONT INTERSECTION OVER CNTRL-ERN PA AND NRN MD WILL FOSTER A CONDITIONAL RISK FOR TORNADOES WITH ANY MORE DISCRETE

sections.title: GRT BASIN/SRN RCKYS ESE TO SRN PLNS/OZARKS THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: SCTD...MAINLY DIURNAL TSTMS ARE EXPECTED AGAIN TODAY FROM PARTS OF NV/UT/CO ESE INTO MUCH OF NM AND W TX...DRIVEN MAINLY BY SFC HEATING AND THE PRESENCE OF ADEQUATE MOISTURE BENEATH MODEST/DIFLUENT UPR-LVL FLOW. DEVELOPMENT OVER THE GRT BASIN MAY BE ENHANCED BY UPR IMPULSE MOVING NE INTO THE LWR CO VLY. OVERALL SETUP SUGGESTS THE POTENTIAL FOR A FEW AFTN/EVE STORMS/STORM CLUSTERS CAPABLE OF ISOLD STRONG GUSTS AND HAIL...ESPECIALLY IN THE HIGHER ELEVATIONS. OTHER STORMS MAY FORM A BIT LATER THIS AFTN INTO TNGT INVOF OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES AND WARM FRONT OVER THE TX PANHANDLE AND PARTS OF OK/NW AR. DEEP FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL BE NEUTRAL TO SLIGHTLY NEGATIVE OVER MOST OF THIS REGION IN WAKE OF NW OK UPR VORT. 30 KT WNWLY CLOUD-LAYER SHEAR MAY...HOWEVER...SUPPORT SOME DEGREE OF STORM ORGANIZATION/SUSTENANCE WITH A RISK FOR LOCALLY SVR WIND/HAIL AS SFC HEATING YIELDS POCKETS OF MLCAPE AROUND 2000 J/KG. PARTS OF THE REGION MAY REQUIRE UPGRADE TO SLIGHT RISK IF CORRIDORS OF FOCUSED LOW-LVL UPLIFT/DESTABILIZATION BECOME MORE APPARENT LATER TODAY. ..CORFIDI/LEITMAN.. 07/09/2015

outlooks.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH DAMAGING WIND AND POSSIBLY A FEW TORNADOES ARE EXPECTED TODAY OVER PARTS OF THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS AND MID-ATLANTIC...INCLUDING THE AREAS MAINLY WEST AND NORTH OF WASHINGTON/BALTIMORE AND PHILADELPHIA. OTHER STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS MAY OCCUR FROM THE GREAT BASIN AND SOUTHERN ROCKIES INTO THE SOUTHERN PLAINS AND OZARK PLATEAU REGION.

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER THE SRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM CNTRL KY TO THE MID-ATLANTIC COAST... ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM THE GREAT BASIN TO OZARK PLATEAU...

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A SPLIT-FLOW PATTERN WILL PREVAIL OVER WRN NORTH AMERICA WITH THE PRIMARY FEATURE OF INTEREST BEING A MID TO UPPER-LEVEL LOW WHICH WILL GRADUALLY EVOLVE INTO AN OPEN WAVE AS THE SYSTEM PIVOTS NEWD THROUGH THE SIERRA NEVADA. FARTHER EAST...THE SEPARATE AIR STREAMS WILL UNIFY OVER THE GREAT LAKES AND OH VALLEY INTO THE NERN U.S. WHERE A BELT OF ENHANCED MID-LEVEL FLOW WILL EXIST. A COUPLE OF EMBEDDED SHORT-WAVE TROUGHS PRESENT WITHIN THIS UPPER-AIR PATTERN WILL BE RELEVANT TO STRONG TO SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT LATER TODAY. ONE LOW-AMPLITUDE DISTURBANCE WILL TRANSLATE FROM THE UPPER OH VALLEY THROUGH THE MID ATLANTIC THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING...WHILE AN UPSTREAM PERTURBATION TRACKS FROM OK INTO THE OZARK PLATEAU. AT THE SURFACE...A MIGRATORY CYCLONE RELATED TO THE FORMER IMPULSE MENTIONED ABOVE WILL UNDERGO SLIGHT DEEPENING WHILE DEVELOPING FROM NRN OH TO THE DE RIVER VALLEY BY LATE EVENING. THIS LOW PRESSURE WILL ADVANCE ALONG A WARM FRONT SLOWLY MOVING NWD THROUGH PA/NJ...WHILE A TRAILING BAROCLINIC ZONE PERSISTS INVOF THE OH RIVER INTO OZARK PLATEAU.

sections.title: MID ATLANTIC REGION THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING
sections.text: POOR MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES OBSERVED BY 12Z RAOBS WILL BE OFFSET BY POCKETS OF STRONGER HEATING AND BOUNDARY-LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 60S TO LOWER 70S TO YIELD AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES APPROACHING 1000 J/KG TO THE SOUTH OF THE WARM FRONT. DCVA ATTENDANT TO THE SYNOPTIC-SCALE SHORT-WAVE TROUGH AND A CONVECTIVELY INDUCED VORTICITY MAXIMUM OVER S-CNTRL OH AS OF LATE MORNING WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE GRADUAL DEVELOPMENT OF STORMS THROUGH MIDDAY WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR OVER PORTIONS OF ERN OH/NRN WV/WRN PA. EXPECT STORMS TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY THIS AFTERNOON WHILE SPREADING EWD THROUGH PA/NRN WV/NRN MD AHEAD OF THE SURFACE LOW WITH ADDITIONAL STORMS LIKELY ALONG A PRE-FRONTAL/LEE TROUGH INTO NRN VA AND EVENTUALLY THE CHESAPEAKE BAY AREA. CURRENT WSR-88D VAD DATA FROM THE UPPER OH VALLEY THIS MORNING INDICATE SEASONABLY STRONG LOWER TO MID-TROPOSPHERIC FLOW WHICH WILL SPREAD EWD TODAY IN TANDEM WITH THE SYNOPTIC SYSTEM...CREATING AN ENVIRONMENT FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS AND/OR BOWING STRUCTURES. WHILE DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY HAZARD...A FEW TORNADOES ARE POSSIBLE...ESPECIALLY WITH SUPERCELLS THAT CAN BECOME SUSTAINED AHEAD OF THE SURFACE LOW AND ALONG THE WARM FRONT

sections.title: CNTRL/SRN HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING
sections.text: IN THE WAKE OF A SHORT-WAVE TROUGH EXITING THE REGION TO THE EAST...WATER VAPOR IMAGERY IS SUGGESTIVE OF A POSSIBLE UPSTREAM IMPULSE NEAR THE AZ-NM BORDER WHICH WILL CONTINUE ENEWD INTO THE CNTRL/SRN ROCKIES TODAY. FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THIS FEATURE MAY AUGMENT LOW-LEVEL UPSLOPE INTO THE HIGH TERRAIN AND/OR CONVERGENCE INVOF A WEAK LEE CYCLONE AND ASSOCIATED TROUGH TO FOSTER WIDELY SCATTERED AFTERNOON STORMS ACROSS ERN PORTIONS OF CO/NM INTO THE OK/TX PNHDLS AND WRN TX. SIMILAR TO WEDNESDAY...THE MOST FAVORABLE OVERLAP OF MODERATE INSTABILITY /I.E. MLCAPE OF 1000-2000 J PER KG/ AND MODEST VERTICAL SHEAR WILL RESIDE OVER THE OK/TX PNHDLS INTO TX SOUTH PLAINS WHERE POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR SPORADIC SUPERCELL STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS.

sections.title: ERN OK INTO SRN MO/AR THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING
sections.text: A NE-SW-ORIENTED BAND OF TSTMS IS ONGOING FROM NERN OK INTO NWRN TX AHEAD OF A SHORT-WAVE TROUGH MOVING THROUGH OK. VISIBLE SATELLITE SUGGESTS THAT FAIRLY STRONG DAYTIME HEATING SHOULD OCCUR AHEAD OF THESE STORMS TODAY...WHICH WHEN COUPLED WITH A VERY MOIST AIR MASS WILL SUPPORT MODERATE INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE OF 1000-2000 J/KG. THIS INSTABILITY COMBINED WITH THE FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO THE MID-LEVEL IMPULSE SHOULD PROMOTE A GRADUAL INCREASE IN STORM COVERAGE AND VIGOR THIS AFTERNOON FROM ERN OK INTO SRN MO AND AR. WHILE DEEP-LAYER FLOW FIELDS ARE NOT PARTICULARLY STRONG...MODEST SWLY WINDS MAY PROMOTE SOME BOWING STRUCTURES WITH A RISK FOR LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS.

sections.title: GREAT BASIN THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING
sections.text: SIMILAR TO THE SETUP ON WEDNESDAY...IT APPEARS THAT A FAVORABLY TIMED VORTICITY MAXIMUM PIVOTING NNEWD FROM THE BASE OF THE PARENT UPPER LOW WILL INTERACT WITH A STEEP-LAPSE-RATE ENVIRONMENT TO FOSTER SCATTERED AFTERNOON/EVENING STORMS CAPABLE OF LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND/OR HAIL. ..MEAD/MOSIER.. 07/09/2015

outlooks.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH DAMAGING WIND AND POSSIBLY A FEW TORNADOES ARE EXPECTED TODAY OVER PARTS OF THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS AND MID-ATLANTIC. OTHER STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS MAY OCCUR FROM THE GREAT BASIN AND SOUTHERN ROCKIES INTO THE SOUTHERN PLAINS AND OZARK PLATEAU REGION.

sections.title: UPDATE
sections.text: ONLY A COUPLE OF CHANGES HAVE BEEN MADE TO THE CURRENT FORECAST. 15 PERCENT WIND PROBABILITIES AND THE CATEGORICAL SLIGHT RISK HAVE BEEN EXPANDED SWWD INTO ERN KY TO ACCOUNT FOR A SMALL...FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS WHICH SHOULD CONTINUE EWD THIS AFTERNOON. ELSEWHERE...TULSA WSR-88D VAD DATA INDICATE SOME POTENTIAL FOR A BRIEF TORNADO OVER NERN OK THIS AFTERNOON OWING TO THE ENHANCEMENT OF VERTICAL SHEAR AHEAD OF THE VORTICITY MAXIMUM MOVING THROUGH THE N-CNTRL PART OF THE STATE. AS SUCH...A TWO PERCENT TORNADO PROBABILITY AREA HAS BEEN ADDED. ..MEAD.. 07/09/2015 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1130 AM CDT THU JUL 09 2015/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE WEATHER INCLUDING THE RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO IS EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY INCREASE THROUGH EARLY AFTERNOON ACROSS WV/FAR SOUTHEAST OH INTO WESTERN PORTIONS OF PA/MD. MONITORING FOR A POSSIBLE WATCH ISSUANCE AS EARLY AS MIDDAY/EARLY AFTERNOON ACROSS PARTS OF THE REGION...WITH A WATCH ISSUANCE BECOMING INCREASINGLY LIKELY WITH EASTWARD EXTENT INTO PA/MD LATER TODAY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: REGIONAL 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDINGS AND MORE CONTEMPORARY WSR-88D VWP DATA SAMPLE A SEASONALLY STRONG DEEP-LAYER WIND FIELD OVER THE OH VALLEY...HIGHLIGHTED BY AS MUCH AS 40-50 KT WEST-SOUTHWESTERLY WINDS WITHIN THE LOWEST 2-5 KM AGL ASSOCIATED WITH AN EASTWARD-MOVING VORT MAX/MCV. A 1011 MB SURFACE LOW NEAR LAKE ERIE AT 15Z WILL CONTINUE EASTWARD TODAY WHILE A TRAILING COLD FRONT ALSO MOVES EASTWARD ACROSS THE MIDDLE/UPPER OH VALLEY. WITHIN THE PRE-COLD FRONT WARM SECTOR...ONE RELATIVELY LOW-TOPPED UPDRAFT/THUNDERSTORM HAS ALREADY EXHIBITED GRADUAL SIGNS OF INTENSIFICATION ACROSS FAR SOUTH-CENTRAL/SOUTHEAST OH AS OF 15Z. ALTHOUGH SOME CLOUD BILLOWS /IMPLICATIONS OF STABILITY/ STILL PERSIST AHEAD OF THIS STORM...THE WARM SECTOR ACROSS WV/SOUTHEAST OH INTO NEARBY SOUTHWEST PA/WESTERN MD CONTINUES TO STEADILY WARM IN CONJUNCTION WITH LOWER 70S F SURFACE DEWPOINTS. THUS...INCREASING STORM DEVELOPMENT/INTENSIFICATION IS PROBABLE INTO THE AFTERNOON INTO WV AND NEARBY PA/MD. A COLLOCATED BELT OF STRENGTHENING WINDS AND WEAK TO MODERATE BUOYANCY WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR ORGANIZED STORM MODES INCLUDING FAST-MOVING LINE SEGMENTS/BOWS AND THE POSSIBILITY OF AT LEAST SOME WEAK/TRANSIENT SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF WIND DAMAGE AND POTENTIALLY SOME TORNADO RISK.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS SHOULD GRADUALLY INTENSIFY/SPREAD EASTWARD INITIALLY ACROSS CENTRAL/EASTERN KY...INTO SOUTHERN WV/FAR WESTERN VA THIS AFTERNOON. SOME OF THE STRONGER STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT...MULTIPLE BANDS OF THUNDERSTORMS HAVE SHOWN SOME INITIAL SIGNS OF INCREASING ORGANIZATION/INTENSIFICATION ACROSS CENTRAL AND EASTERN KY AS OF 16Z. THIS DEVELOPMENT IS OCCURRING WITHIN A ZONE OF PRE-FRONTAL DIFFERENTIAL CLOUD COVER/HEATING...WHERE NEAR 80/LOWER 80S F SURFACE TEMPERATURES AND LOWER 70S F SURFACE DEWPOINTS ARE ALREADY LEADING TO NEGLIGIBLE INHIBITION WITH 1000+ J/KG MLCAPE AND DEEPENING CU FIELD. THE REGION WILL GENERALLY BE REMOVED FROM THE STRONGER LARGE-SCALE FORCING/VERTICAL SHEAR TO THE NORTH/NORTHEAST. HOWEVER...A MODERATELY STRONG BELT OF MID-LEVEL WESTERLIES...WITH 40-50 KT BETWEEN 2-6 KM AGL EVIDENT FROM JKL/LVX/HPX WSR-88D VWP DATA...WILL SUPPORT RELATIVELY FAST/EASTWARD-MOVING LINE SEGMENTS/ORGANIZED LINEAR STRUCTURES WITH BOWING SEGMENTS CAPABLE OF WIND DAMAGE AS STORMS CONTINUE TO GRADUALLY MATURE/INTENSIFY THIS AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A TORNADO WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED FOR AN INCREASING DAMAGING WIND/ISOLATED TORNADO RISK BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON PARTICULARLY ACROSS CENTRAL/EASTERN PORTIONS OF PA/MD/WV AND ADJACENT FAR NORTHERN VA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SURFACE LOW CONTINUES TO SHIFT EASTWARD ACROSS LAKE ERIE VICINITY TOWARD NORTHERN PA EARLY THIS AFTERNOON...WHILE A PRECEDING WARM FRONT WILL CONTINUE TO GRADUALLY SPREAD NORTHWARD ACROSS PA/NJ. UPSTREAM STORMS CURRENTLY ACROSS NORTHERN WV/FAR SOUTHWEST PA AT 17Z SHOULD FURTHER INCREASE AND POTENTIALLY GROW UPSCALE OVER TIME...WHILE ADDITIONAL/SEMI-DISCRETE STORMS SHOULD ALSO DEVELOP/INCREASE JUST AHEAD OF/PERIPHERAL TO THIS ACTIVITY. INITIAL SIGNS OF THIS MAY ALREADY BE OCCURRING ACROSS CENTRAL PA COINCIDENT WITH A DEEPENING CU FIELD PER VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY AMID AN INCREASINGLY UNSTABLE/WEAKLY INHIBITED WARM SECTOR. ORGANIZED STORM MODES INCLUDING WHAT MAY BE A COMBINATION OF SEMI-DISCRETE SUPERCELLS AND AN UPSCALE-GROWING CONVECTIVE LINE/BOWS WILL BE AIDED BY A SEASONALLY STRONG STRENGTHENING BELT OF LOW/MID-TROPOSPHERIC WEST-SOUTHWESTERLY WINDS AS NOTED IN UPSTREAM UPPER-AIR OBSERVATIONS. DAMAGING WINDS CAN BE EXPECTED WITH THE STRONGER STORMS...WITH SOME TORNADO POTENTIAL AS WELL...PARTICULARLY IN CLOSER PROXIMITY TO THE SURFACE LOW/WARM FRONT ACROSS PA /AND EVENTUALLY NJ/.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTM ACTIVITY WILL INCREASE ACROSS THE REGION WITH ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL POSSIBLE. SVR THREAT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN TOO ISOLATED FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTM COVERAGE IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE DURING THE EARLY AFTERNOON AS DAYTIME HEATING DESTABILIZES THE AIRMASS AND A SHORTWAVE TROUGH ROTATES THROUGH THE LARGE UPPER LOW CENTERED OVER CNTRL CA AND INTO THE WRN GREAT BASIN. REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY HAS SHOWN A FEW STRONG STORMS NEAR RENO AS WELL AS ADDITIONAL ACTIVITY FARTHER E ACROSS CNTRL NV INCREASING IN COVERAGE AND STRENGTH. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY REVEALS AN EXPANSIVE CU FIELD ACROSS CNTRL NV INDICATIVE OF INCREASED MID-LEVEL MOISTURE AND BROAD SYNOPTIC LIFT ASSOCIATED WITH THE UPPER LOW. LINE OF TSTMS S OF THE MCD AREA FROM ROUGHLY MMH /IN FAR E-CNTRL CA/ SWD INTO THE MOHAVE DESERT LIKELY DEMARCATES AN AREA OF ENHANCED LIFT ASSOCIATED WITH A SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING AROUND THE UPPER LOW. THE CONTINUED NEWD PROGRESS OF THIS SHORTWAVE COUPLED WITH INCREASED MID-LEVEL MOISTURE AND AT LEAST MODEST DAYTIME HEATING IS EXPECTED TO FOSTER CONTINUED TSTM ACTIVITY. DRY ADIABATIC LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL HELP PROMOTE INVERTED-V PROFILES WITH AT LEAST SOME POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WITH THE STRONGER UPDRAFTS. ADDITIONALLY...GIVEN THE COOLING MID-LEVEL TEMPERATURES AND RESULTING INCREASE IN MID-LEVEL LEVEL LAPSE RATE AND INSTABILITY...SOME HAIL IS ALSO POSSIBLE. HOWEVER...THE OVERALL SVR THREAT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN TOO MARGINAL AND ISOLATED FOR WW ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DAMAGING WIND/ISOLATED TORNADO POTENTIAL IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE/SPREAD EASTWARD THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON ACROSS PARTS OF PA AND NEARBY NORTHERN WV/MD. TORNADO WATCH 397 CONTINUES UNTIL 01Z. AN ADDITIONAL WATCH IS LIKELY BY LATE AFTERNOON /APPROX 20-21Z/ ESPECIALLY FOR PORTIONS OF EASTERN PA AND NJ/DE/NORTHEAST MD.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 18Z SUBJECTIVE SURFACE ANALYSIS FEATURES AN EASTWARD-MOVING SURFACE LOW ACROSS FAR WESTERN NY/NORTHWEST PA...WITH PRECEDING 2-3 MB TWO-HOURLY PRESSURE FALLS ACROSS SOUTH-CENTRAL NY/NORTH-CENTRAL PA. A WAVY/NORTHWARD-SHIFTING WARM FRONT EXTENDS EAST-SOUTHWARD FROM THE SURFACE LOW ACROSS ACROSS NORTH-CENTRAL/EASTERN PA INTO NJ. AS OF 19Z/3PM EDT...A NARROW/BOWING CONVECTIVE LINE CONTINUES TO GRADUALLY GROW UPSCALE AND MOVE EASTWARD ACROSS SOUTHWEST PA/FAR WESTERN MD...WHILE FARTHER NORTH...WITH OTHER LOWER-TOPPED SEMI-DISCRETE STORMS INCLUDING A COUPLE OF SUPERCELLS CONTINUE TO FLUCTUATE INTENSITY-WISE ACROSS WEST-CENTRAL PA. AHEAD OF THIS ACTIVITY...VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SUGGESTS THAT THE CUMULUS FIELD CONTINUES TO BECOME INCREASING AGITATED/DEEPEN WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR PARTICULARLY ACROSS PA/NJ WHERE MLCAPE IS ESTIMATED TO BE AT LEAST 500-1000 J/KG COINCIDENT WITH UPPER 60S/LOWER 70S F SURFACE DEWPOINTS. SIMILAR TO PREVIOUSLY DESCRIBED CONVECTIVE TRENDS...LATEST THINKING IS THAT THE EASTWARD-MOVING BAND OF STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO GROW UPSCALE/ACCELERATE EASTWARD ACROSS EASTERN/NORTHERN WV AND MD/SOUTHERN PA...WITH OTHER SEMI-DISCRETE STORMS/SUPERCELLS REMAINING A DISTINCT POSSIBILITY FARTHER NORTH /AND POSSIBLY EAST AHEAD OF THE LINE/ ACROSS ADDITIONAL PORTIONS OF PA/NJ AND DELMARVA VICINITY. WHILE DAMAGING WINDS ARE LIKELY TO BE THE MOST PREVALENT RISK...TORNADO POTENTIAL WILL EXIST...PARTICULARLY WITH ANY SUPERCELLS INTERACTING WITH THE WARM FRONT ACROSS PA/NJ. LATEST WSR-88D VWP DATA FROM STATE COLLEGE IS SAMPLING 0-1 KM SRH OF APPROXIMATELY 200 M2/S2...WITH LOCALLY HIGHER VALUES WHERE LOW-LEVEL WINDS ARE BACKED TO MORE SOUTHEASTERLY /SUCH AS THE THE WILLIAMSPORT VICINITY AS OF 18Z-19Z/. ..GUYER.. 07/09/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTM ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE ACROSS PORTIONS OF NE/E-CNTRL NM AND THE WRN TX/OK PANHANDLES DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. A WW MAY BE NEEDED TO COVER THE ANTICIPATED SVR THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT SURFACE OBSERVATIONS INDICATE A CONTINUED WWD/NWWD PUSH OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE INTO THE REGION WITH DHT...CVS...AND HRX NOW REPORTING DEWPOINTS OF 63...66...AND 67 DEG F...RESPECTIVELY. MOSTLY CLEAR TO PARTLY CLOUDY SKIES HAVE ALLOWED FOR SUFFICIENT ISOLATION WITH TEMPERATURES IN THE LOW 80S ACROSS THE MUCH OF THE AREA. THESE SURFACE CONDITIONS COMBINED WITH MODEST MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AROUND 7 DEG C PER KM ARE RESULTING IN MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY WITH MESOANALYSIS ESTIMATING MLCAPE OVER 2000 J PER KG. CONTINUED HEATING WITH ACT TO FURTHER INCREASE INSTABILITY ACROSS THE REGION. CURRENT KINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT IS NOT ALL THAT FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS WITH 0-6 KM BULK SHEAR LESS THAN 30 KT AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR AROUND 20 TO 25 KT. HOWEVER...SHEAR IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE AS A SHORTWAVE TROUGH NOW MOVING ACROSS THE AZ/NM BORDER CONTINUES EWD. THIS SHORTWAVE WILL ALSO PROVIDE MORE SYNOPTIC SCALE LIFT TO AUGMENT MESOSCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT EXPECTED ALONG OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES AND THE LEE TROUGH. THE RESULT OF ALL THESE FACTORS WILL BE INCREASED TSTM ACTIVITY ACROSS NE/E-CNTRL NM AND THE WRN TX/OK PANHANDLES DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. SOME SUPERCELLS ARE POSSIBLE WITH A RESULTING HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND THREAT. GIVEN THE WIDESPREAD COVERAGE EXPECTED...AMALGAMATION ALONG COOL POOLS IS POSSIBLE WITH THE RESULTING BOWING SEGMENTS FAVORING A CONTINUED WIND DAMAGE THREAT. A WW MAY BE NEEDED TO COVER THE EXPECTED SVR THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE POTENTIAL FOR LOCALIZED WIND DAMAGE AND/OR A BRIEF TORNADO WILL EXIST WITHIN A CORRIDOR FROM NORTHEAST OK INTO FAR SOUTHERN MO/FAR NORTHERN AR THROUGH THE LATE AFTERNOON AND EARLY/MID-EVENING. A WATCH ISSUANCE CURRENTLY APPEARS UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MULTIPLE BANDS OF STORMS WITH A FEW PERIPHERAL SEMI-DISCRETE STORMS...INCLUDING AT LEAST ONE STORM WITH WEAK SUPERCELL CHARACTERISTICS ACROSS FAR SOUTH-CENTRAL MO...CONTINUE TO MOVE EAST-NORTHEASTWARD AS OF 2015Z WITH SOME GRADUAL INTENSIFICATION FROM NORTHEAST OK INTO FAR SOUTHERN MO/NORTHERN AR. THIS DEVELOPMENT IS SEMI-FOCUSED NEAR/AHEAD OF A VORT MAX/REMNANT MCV...AND ALONG RESIDUAL OUTFLOW/S ACROSS OK AND OTHERWISE NEAR AN EFFECTIVE FRONTAL ZONE EXTENDING EASTWARD ACROSS FAR SOUTHERN MO. WHILE MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE WEAK...A MODESTLY WARM BOUNDARY LAYER /SEMI-COOL BY JULY STANDARDS/ IS CONTRIBUTING TO WEAK INHIBITION AND APPROXIMATELY 500-1000 J/KG MLCAPE IN THE PRESENCE OF LOWER 70S F SURFACE DEWPOINTS. RELATED TO THE MCV/VORT MAX...AN ENHANCED BELT OF LOW/MID-LEVEL WINDS EXISTS NEAR THE EFFECTIVE FRONTAL CORRIDOR...WITH 30-40 KT SOUTHWESTERLY WINDS BETWEEN 2-6 KM AS SAMPLED BY WSR-88D VWP DATA FROM OKLAHOMA CITY/TULSA AND SPRINGFIELD MO. IN PARTICULAR...LATEST TULSA WSR-88D VWP DATA FEATURES NEARLY 300 M2/S2 0-1 KM SRH. OVERALL SCENARIO SHOULD SUPPORT AT LEAST A FEW POTENTIALLY SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITHIN THIS CORRIDOR...INCLUDING A MIXED-MODE MODE OF BANDS/LINEAR SEGMENTS AND POTENTIALLY SOME SEMI-DISCRETE/EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS. A FEW STORMS COULD PRODUCE LOCALIZED WIND DAMAGE AND/OR A BRIEF TORNADO THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON AND EARLY/MID-EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DAMAGING WIND/ISOLATED TORNADO POTENTIAL CONTINUES...AND MAY SOMEWHAT INCREASE...PARTICULARLY ACROSS MUCH OF EAST-CENTRAL PA AND POSSIBLY NEARBY MARYLAND THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. TORNADO WATCH 397 CONTINUES UNTIL 01Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MODEST DESTABILIZATION CONTINUES TO OCCUR WITHIN A WARM/MOIST SECTOR TO THE SOUTH/SOUTHEAST OF A SURFACE LOW ALONG THE SOUTH-CENTRAL NY/NORTH-CENTRAL PA BORDER VICINITY AND ALONG/SOUTH OF A SLOW-NORTHWARD-SHIFTING WARM FRONT EXTENDING ACROSS NORTH-CENTRAL/NORTHEAST PA SOUTHEASTWARD INTO NJ AS OF 20Z. WHILE UPDRAFT INTENSITY HAS BEEN SOMEWHAT TEMPERED BY WEAK MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES/MODEST BUOYANCY...STEADY WARMING CONTINUES TO OCCUR LATE THIS AFTERNOON WITH INCREASING DESTABILIZATION TO THE EAST OF THE CURRENT CONVECTION...WHICH MAY CONTRIBUTE TO AN UPTICK IN INTENSITY OVER THE NEXT FEW OURS ACROSS EAST-CENTRAL PA/NEARBY MD AND POINTS DOWNSTREAM...WHERE A NEW WATCH /398/ HAS BEEN RECENTLY COORDINATED. VARIOUS REGIONAL WSR-88D VWP PROFILES...INCLUDING CHARLESTON WV/STATE COLLEGE PA/BALTIMORE-WASHINGTON...CONTINUE TO SAMPLE AN EASTWARD-SHIFTING BELT OF STRONG WESTERLY WINDS ALOFT WHICH WILL REMAIN QUITE FAVORABLE FOR CONTINUED SUPERCELL POTENTIAL AND FAST-EASTWARD-MOVING LINE SEGMENTS/BOWS. DAMAGING WIND/ISOLATED TORNADO POTENTIAL WILL EXIST PARTICULARLY WITHIN THE EASTERN PORTION OF TORNADO WATCH 397. ..GUYER.. 07/09/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FOCUSED SWATH OF TREE DAMAGE IS POSSIBLE THROUGH ABOUT 02Z WITH STRONG WIND GUSTS ACCOMPANYING AN EWD-MOVING CLUSTER FROM S-CNTRL KY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SMALL TSTM CLUSTER CENTERED OVER PULASKI COUNTY KY APPEARS LIKELY TO EVOLVE EWD ALONG THE TRAILING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM A NOW DECAYED CLUSTER THAT HAS REMNANTS ACROSS SRN WV. S OF THIS OUTFLOW...SURFACE TEMPERATURES IN THE MIDDLE 80S TO LOWER 90S WILL SUPPORT DOWNWARD MOMENTUM TRANSPORT OF AROUND 40-KT 3-KM AGL WLYS SAMPLED IN JKL/LVX VWP DATA. GIVEN A RECENT MEASURED GUST AT KSME OF 32 KT WITHIN THIS CLUSTER...STRONG WIND GUSTS SHOULD PERSIST OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS WHICH MAY RESULT IN A SWATH OF TREE DAMAGE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW THUNDERSTORMS LATE THIS AFTERNOON INTO THIS EVENING MAY PRODUCE GUSTY WINDS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL. HOWEVER...THE NATURE OF THE SEVERE THREAT SHOULD BE FAIRLY UNORGANIZED...PRECLUDING WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FEW THUNDERSTORMS ACROSS THE MCD AREA HAVE ACQUIRED TRANSIENT ROTATION/SUPERCELLULAR STRUCTURES THIS AFTERNOON...WITH THE REGION ON THE EDGE OF A CORE OF STRONGER FLOW ALOFT TO THE WEST. REGIONAL VWP DATA INDICATE AROUND 25-30 KTS OF 0-6-KM SHEAR IS AVAILABLE FOR UPDRAFT ORGANIZATION. ALTHOUGH MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE NOT PARTICULARLY STEEP FOR THE TIME OF YEAR...FAVORABLE LOW/MID-LEVEL MOISTURE IS YIELDING AROUND 500-1500 J/KG OF MLCAPE PER RECENT MESOANALYSIS. THEREFORE...A FEW CELLS MAY ACQUIRE BRIEF ROTATION...ENHANCING THE THREAT FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS/MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL. HOWEVER...THE FAIRLY MODEST NATURE OF THE KINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT...AS WELL AS THE LACK OF STEEPER MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...SUGGEST THE THREAT SHOULD BE RELATIVELY UNORGANIZED. THUS...WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG WIND GUSTS PRIMARILY PRODUCING TREE DAMAGE WILL REMAIN PROBABLE AS A SMALL QLCS EVOLVES E FROM WW 397 INTO WW 398...MAINLY ACROSS SERN PA AND MOST OF NJ INTO NRN MD/DE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MEASURED WIND GUSTS OF 35-45 KT HAVE BEEN COMMON WITH PASSAGE OF THE QLCS ACROSS S-CNTRL PA/N-CNTRL MD...REF KMDT/KCXY/KDMW/KLNS METARS. DOWNSTREAM AIR MASS REMAINS RELATIVELY WARM /OUTSIDE OF THE IMMEDIATE COASTAL AREA/...WITH SURFACE TEMPERATURES IN THE LOWER TO MIDDLE 80S. THIS SHOULD BE SUPPORTIVE OF CONTINUED DOWNWARD MOMENTUM TRANSPORT OF AROUND 40-45 KT 3-KM AGL WLY FLOW /AS SAMPLED BY LWX VWP DATA/. GIVEN THE NEARLY PERPENDICULAR NATURE OF MID-LEVEL FLOW TO THE ORIENTATION OF THE LINE /ESPECIALLY ACROSS SERN PA/...THE RISK FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS MAY BE GREATEST TOWARDS THE PHILADELPHIA AND TRENTON AREAS AROUND 00Z. NRN PORTION OF WW 398 ACROSS NERN PA MAY STRUGGLE TO REALIZE STRONG WINDS GIVEN PREDOMINANT STRATIFORM CHARACTER AND WEAKER INSTABILITY WITH NRN EXTENT. ..GRAMS.. 07/09/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONVECTION DEVELOPING S OF WW 397 MAY EVENTUALLY ORGANIZE ACROSS PARTS OF THE DELMARVA...WHICH COULD REQUIRE AN ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE AND/OR LOCAL WFO EXTENSIONS OF EXISTING WW/S.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SHOWERS HAVE INCREASED S OF ONGOING TSTMS/QLCS WITHIN WW/S 397/398 ALONG A SURFACE TROUGH ANALYZED THROUGH THE DC AREA INTO CNTRL VA. RECENT ESRL-HRRR RUNS SUGGEST THIS CONVECTION WILL INTENSIFY PRIMARILY OVER THE CHESAPEAKE BAY AREA...INTO PARTS OF THE DELMARVA PENINSULA. BUT WITH 2-KM AGL WLYS NEAR 40 KT SAMPLED AS FAR S AS FCX/AKQ IN VWP DATA...IT SEEMS PLAUSIBLE THAT CONVECTION COULD BECOME ORGANIZED EVEN FARTHER S TOWARDS THE RICHMOND AREA. WITH MIDDLE 80S TO LOWER 90S SURFACE TEMPERATURES AND LOWER TO MIDDLE 70S DEW POINTS LIKELY YIELDING MODERATE BUOYANCY...FURTHER SWD INTENSIFICATION OF CONVECTION WOULD PROBABLY RESULT IN A RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS S OF THE EXISTING WW/S.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A CLUSTER OF STRONG STORMS SHOULD CONTINUE TO PROGRESS EAST OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS...WITH AN ATTENDANT THREAT FOR A FEW MARGINALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS. HOWEVER...WW ISSUANCE IS NOT EXPECTED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A STOUT BOWING SEGMENT WAS PROGRESSING EWD TOWARDS THE CONFLUENCE OF THE MS/OH RIVERS AROUND 30 KTS AS OF 23Z. RECENT KPAH DATA DEPICT APPROX 50-KT WINDS AROUND 5000 FT AGL WITH THIS LINE. ADDITIONALLY...NEW CONVECTION IS INITIATING TO ITS EAST ALONG A COMPOSITE WARM FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. SUFFICIENT INSOLATION AND SFC DEW POINTS IN THE LOWER TO MID 70S ARE YIELDING UPWARDS OF 1500-2500 J/KG OF MLCAPE ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR AHEAD OF THE BOWING SEGMENT. IN COMBINATION WITH THIS FAVORABLE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT...AN ASSOCIATED MCV IS LIKELY AIDING CONVECTIVE INITIATION TO THE EAST...AS WELL AS SUSTENANCE OF THE LINE. AS SUCH...MODESTLY ENHANCED MID-LEVEL FLOW AROUND 30-35 KTS SHOULD WORK IN CONCERT WITH COLD-POOL AMALGAMATION TO YIELD AT LEAST A MARGINAL WIND THREAT THIS EVENING. THE LIMITED SPATIAL NATURE OF THE THREAT SHOULD PRECLUDE WW ISSUANCE HOWEVER.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG WIND GUSTS CAPABLE OF TREE DAMAGE WILL LIKELY DIMINISH IN SPATIAL EXTENT BY LATE EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG VELOCITIES ASSOCIATED WITH A SHORT QLCS HAVE BECOME INCREASINGLY CONFINED/SHUNTED SWD FOLLOWING THE LINGERING PLUME OF MODEST BUOYANCY AS SAMPLED BY MODIFIED 00Z WAL RAOB. WITH A PRONOUNCED MARINE-LAYER INFLUENCE ACROSS E-CNTRL NJ ON N...THE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT SUPPORTIVE OF STRONG MOMENTUM TRANSFER SHOULD BE RELEGATED TO SRN NJ SWD TO THE DELMARVA PENINSULA DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. PRESENCE OF 30-40 KT WLYS AROUND 700 MB IN 00Z IAD/WAL RAOBS SHOULD BE SUPPORTIVE OF SURFACE GUSTS OF SIMILAR INTENSITY /AS MEASURED BY KILG AND KPHL/ UNTIL CONVECTION CLEARS THE COAST. ..GRAMS.. 07/10/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A BAND OF STRONG CONVECTION SHOULD PROGRESS EWD ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE OZARKS THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS. A MARGINAL THREAT FOR A FEW STRONG GUSTS AND/OR A BRIEF/WEAK TORNADO WILL EXIST. HOWEVER...THE LIMITED NATURE OF THE THREAT SHOULD PRECLUDE WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT RADAR IMAGERY INDICATES A STRONG/MARGINALLY SEVERE LINE OF CONVECTION /STRETCHING FROM LACLEDE COUNTY MO TO BOONE COUNTY AR/ IS PROGRESSING EWD AROUND 30 KTS. WHILE THESE STORMS ARE ENTERING A REGION CHARACTERIZED BY AIR SOMEWHAT CONTAMINATED BY EARLIER CONVECTION...THEY ARE LIKELY BEING MAINTAINED BY FORCING FOR ASCENT FROM A WEAK IMPULSE ALOFT...AS WELL AS AN MCV ACROSS SRN MO. REGIONAL VWPS CONTINUE TO DISPLAY AROUND 30-40 KTS OF W/SWLY MID-LEVEL FLOW...SUPPORTIVE OF A FEW BOWING SEGMENTS CAPABLE OF A MARGINALLY SEVERE GUST OR TWO. ADDITIONALLY...WHILE NEAR-SFC FLOW IS WEAK...AMPLE LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE MAY OFFER THE OPPORTUNITY FOR A BRIEF TORNADO IN ANY LINE-EMBEDDED CIRCULATIONS...ESPECIALLY ACROSS SRN PORTIONS OF THE LINE. HOWEVER...AS THE LINE PROGRESSES EWD THIS EVENING...MODEST BL COOLING/INCREASING CINH SHOULD RESULT IN A GRADUAL WEAKENING TREND. THEREFORE...WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS HAVE DEVELOPED ACROSS WW 399...WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS AS THE MAIN THREATS. CONVECTION SHOULD SLOWLY PROGRESS N/EWD ACROSS THE WATCH THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF THE EVENING. ADDITIONALLY...A FEW STRONG/MARGINALLY SEVERE CELLS HAVE PROGRESSED/DEVELOPED JUST NORTH OF THE WATCH ACROSS SERN CO/SWRN KS. HOWEVER...THE SMALL SPATIAL SCALE OF THE THREAT PRECLUDES WATCH ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MULTIPLE CLUSTERS OF STRONG/SEVERE CONVECTION HAVE OVERSPREAD THE WATCH THIS EVENING...WITH THE TWO PRIMARY AREAS OVER THE OK PANHANDLE/FAR NRN TX PANHANDLE AND PORTIONS OF THE WRN LUB CWA. THE 00Z AMA RAOB SAMPLED MLCAPE OF AROUND 1600 J/KG. WHILE LOW-MID-LEVEL FLOW IS NOT PARTICULARLY STRONG...DIRECTIONAL SHEAR /IN COMBINATION WITH ADEQUATE BUOYANCY IN THE HAIL GROWTH ZONE/ APPEARS FAVORABLE FOR UPDRAFT ORGANIZATION AND SUBSEQUENT LARGE-HAIL GROWTH IN CELLS THAT CAN REMAIN AT LEAST SEMI-DISCRETE. INDEED...1.75-IN HAIL WAS REPORTED IN CIMARRON COUNTY OK AT 0120Z. ADDITIONALLY...UPPER-LEVEL FLOW OF 70-80 KTS NEAR THE EQUILIBRIUM LEVEL SHOULD SUPPLY VENTING FOR MORE VIGOROUS UPDRAFTS. AS SUCH...THE SEVERE THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS WW 399. A FEW STRONG/MARGINALLY SEVERE CELLS HAVE DEVELOPED JUST NORTH OF THE WATCH AS WELL...AS STRONG OUTFLOW HAS FAVORED NWD PROPAGATION HERE. HOWEVER...DECREASING THETA-E TO THE NORTH OF THE CURRENT WATCH SHOULD LIMIT THE SPATIAL EXTENT OF ANY LARGE HAIL/STRONG WIND THREAT HERE...AND NEW WATCH ISSUANCE IS NOT EXPECTED. ..PICCA.. 07/10/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: OVERALL SEVERE RISK APPEARS TO BE MINIMAL WITH ONLY SMALL HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS EXPECTED INTO THE OVERNIGHT WITH TSTM CLUSTERS MOVING E AROUND 10-20 KT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 5 AND 9-KM CAPPI REFLECTIVITY VALUES HAVE WANED OVER THE PAST HOUR WITH INCREASINGLY RELAXED GRADIENTS IN BASE REFLECTIVITY AS WELL. GIVEN PROGRESSIVELY MORE MARGINAL BUOYANCY WITH ERN EXTENT PER 00Z OUN/FWD RAOBS AND NOCTURNAL BOUNDARY-LAYER STABILIZATION...THERE APPEARS TO BE LITTLE REASON FOR AN ORGANIZED RISK TO REDEVELOP. PARTS/MUCH OF THE WW MAY BE CANCELLED PRIOR TO 06Z EXPIRATION. ..GRAMS.. 07/10/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
